newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha nervously steady at lower levels.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha nervously steady at lower levels.

text.p: NWE naphtha prices were holding nervously steady at the lower levels with crude gains looking shaky in late business but trade was thin, dealers said.
"It depends on company year-end stock strategies but most appear to be covered, apart from some small requirements, through to mid-Jan," a trader said.

Traders said that because of the dearth of demand there was little premium for high quality material while full range supplies looked balanced to over-supplied and weak gasoline markets had left demand for reforming naphtha muted.
Physical cargoes were pegged notionally around $218-$225 at tonne cif NWE.
